LanguageData.RimWard.Guide.1.Title: Open the hospital
LanguageData.RimWard.Guide.1.Text: The switch at the top of this tab opens and closes the hospital. While it is open, patients arrive by drop pod during the opening hours (Policies page). Closing it never sends anyone away who is already here.
LanguageData.RimWard.Guide.2.Title: Beds and rooms
LanguageData.RimWard.Guide.2.Text: A patient bed is a medical bed with its "Hospital Bed" switch on; surgery cases need a bed with "Surgery Bed" on. A room of their own pays most, a two-bed room a little more than usual, a ward and a hallway less.
LanguageData.RimWard.Guide.3.Title: Who gets in
LanguageData.RimWard.Guide.3.Text: In the Firehose intake mode patients just arrive. Hybrid and Prompt send an offer first: answer it in the Inbox or in its letter. Declining is free. Nobody comes when all patient beds are taken or danger is on the map.
LanguageData.RimWard.Guide.4.Title: Money
LanguageData.RimWard.Guide.4.Text: Every treatment adds a line to the patient's bill. On discharge the room, your best doctor, renown and the payment scale set the price, up to the cap in the settings. The Patients page shows what each patient is expected to pay; the invoice lists every line.
LanguageData.RimWard.Guide.5.Title: When things go wrong
LanguageData.RimWard.Guide.5.Text: A patient who dies through neglect costs goodwill with their faction. Deaths on the operating table, after you sent them home or right after arrival are not your fault. A treatment that cannot be done sends a letter first and the patient home later, without a penalty.
LanguageData.RimWard.Guide.6.Title: Hearth & Harbor
LanguageData.RimWard.Guide.6.Text: With Hearth & Harbor loaded, one bed button sets a bed to colonist, guest, patient or surgery patient, and patients who are up and about may use its spa while they recover. Without it nothing changes.
